title: Baa Juice Pink Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Pink Lemonade Nic Salt serves up a sparkling blend of sweet mixed fruits with a zesty Lemonade edge. The flavour balances fruity sweetness with tangy citrus for a lively vape that stays bright and satisfying. As part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this e-liquid is crafted with double-concentrated flavour to mirror the impactful taste of bar-style vapes. Blended at 50VG/50PG, it’s designed for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) vaping, providing strong flavour delivery, discreet vapour and a reliable throat hit. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Baa Juice Pink Lemonade is an easy pick for fans of citrus fruit blends and classic drink-inspired flavours.
